extracted_concepts.name: L'Hôpital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A method for evaluating limits of indeterminate forms using derivatives.

extracted_concepts.name: Indeterminate Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expressions where limit rules fail directly, requiring transformation.

extracted_concepts.name: Zero Over Zero Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where both numerator and denominator approach zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinity Over Infinity Case
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Case where both numerator and denominator approach infinity.

extracted_concepts.name: Zero Times Infinity Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Product of zero and infinity, rewritten as a fraction.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinity Minus Infinity Form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Difference of infinities, combined into a single fraction.

extracted_concepts.name: Power Indeterminate Forms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Forms like 1^∞, 0^0, ∞^0 solved by taking logarithms.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit Computation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Process of determining the value a function approaches.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Finding the derivative of a function.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio of Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fraction formed by dividing the derivative of the numerator by the derivative of the denominator.

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor's Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Expresses a function as a polynomial plus a remainder term using derivatives at a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Maclaurin Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taylor series expansion centered at a = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Remainder Term
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Error component R_n that determines polynomial approximation accuracy.

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent Line Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: First-order linear approximation of a function near a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Higher-Order Derivatives
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Successive derivatives beyond the first, used for curvature and series terms.

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of infinitely many terms, often representing functions.

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series expansion for e^x given by Σ xⁿ/n!.

extracted_concepts.name: Sine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series expansion for sin x with alternating odd powers.

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series expansion for cos x with alternating even powers.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series expansion for 1/(1-x) converging for |x| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Series expansion for ln(1+x) with alternating harmonic coefficients.

extracted_concepts.name: Polynomial Approximation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Using finite-degree polynomials to estimate function values.

extracted_concepts.name: Calculus Unification
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connection linking differentiation, integration, and infinite series.
